triage.note: Pins the three silent-breakage shapes of the S8 wire as known-bad fixtures, at an EXACT count so that both a regressed miss (too few) and a regressed over-fire (too many) go red — PR #21 round-2 R5's rule: a floor alone would let a check that ALSO flags the two correctly-wired call sites report green. The three, one per failure: the checkbox ships `checked` (ADR-026 is opt-in and OFF must remain today's behaviour); the upload mode does not send the flag (works in two modes out of three, and upload is the guaranteed path an evaluator uses); `_run` accepts the flag and then calls `extract_items(path)` anyway, so every request is byte-identical whatever the checkbox says. The fixtures are correctly wired everywhere else, so the check has to distinguish rather than blanket-fail.

provenance: S8, created 2026-08-22 alongside ui-boilerplate-exclusion, per hard rule 2.
